newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian YUKOS' Samusev declines energy post - YUKO.
newsitem.headline: Russian YUKOS' Samusev declines energy post - YUKO.

text.p: Alexander Samusev, a senior official at a company closely attached to giant oil producer YUKOS, has declined a government offer to become Russia's fuel and energy minister, YUKOS said on Tuesday.

A YUKOS spokesman said Samusev had turned down the proposal for health reasons. There was no independent confirmation of whether the government had formally offered Samusev the job to replace Pyotr Rodionov, who tendered his resignation last week.
YUKOS said Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin had offered Samusev the job last week.
Samusev would undergo unspecified health treatment in April and May, which would interfere with his ability to be minister, the spokesman said.
Rodionov had said earlier on Tuesday that Samusev was the only name he had heard as his replacement.
First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov, a young reformist in charge of restructuring natural monopolies, is said to have in mind his own candidate.
